note: Scene 3 (café) routines, v10d. Holds in ms; [a,b] = random in range. Each actor runs independently and out of sync. RULE: fade_ms (a true cross-dissolve into a still) applies ONLY between two stills of the same loop. Every other change is an instant cut. Within a layer every still is pixel-identical to the first outside the part that moves, so cuts never flicker. The fan is part of the room: play its loop forever, do not apply the 'fully painted under actors' edge rule to it, and let the edge fade it like the plate. v10d (2026-11-26): OLD MAN reads on O_1 only (the newspaper never changes) and turns a page every 5-7 s in five drawn steps, cuts: O_1 > T1 (corner lifted) > T2 (page curled up on the right of the fold) > R0 (page standing upright over the fold, his fingers just leaving it) > R1 (he has let go: the page falls to the left on its own, his hand halfway back outside the paper's right edge) > R2 (page almost flat over the left page, hand back in its reading grip) > O_1, 130/140/130/170/160 ms (0.73 s; R0 short so the page passes upright quickly but visibly, R1 a little longer while the page falls, R2 long enough to see it settle). His arm never crosses the front of the paper (v10.1's T2b/T3/T3b/T4 are gone). He blinks on O_1 only, about every 3-6.5 s (O_blink, 100 ms), never mid-turn. BARISTA polishes in a circle, cuts at 140-200 ms: B_1 > B_P1 > B_2_polish > B_P2 > B_3_polish > B_P3, 3-6 rounds, then her pause and glance (B_4_glance) as before. v10b (2026-11-26): MUM (part of the plate; her layer holds patches only) sips at the START of her loop of about 22-23 s (21-25 s at the extremes): nothing for 50 ms (so her rest pose stays the plate) > M_S1 (220 ms) > M_S2 (sip, eyes closed, 1.4-1.8 s) > M_S1 > rest; then her four blinks spread through the rest of the loop (the first 2.3-2.9 s after the sip, then every 4.3-5.1 s, the last 2.7-3.3 s before the next sip), never during the sip. CAT: cat_3 is gone. Its tail flicks twice per loop: cat_1 > cat_F1 (110 ms) > cat_F2 (500 ms) > cat_F1 (110 ms) > cat_1, at the start of the loop and again after 3 breaths (2 more follow), so at about 60% of the loop. It breathes (cat_1/cat_2, 1 s dissolves) the rest of the time, never during a flick; each breathing loop ends on cat_1 so the flick starts with a cut from an identical body.

reaction.note: On a mushroom find. Stills only; the head lift is hidden inside a blink.

rachel.note: The coffee sip is four drawn poses with cuts: A1 > S1 (stylus down, hand to cup) > S2 (cup lifted, eyes half closed) > B1 (sip) and back. No blink during S1/S2/B1. If a mushroom is found mid-sip, finish the sip (B1 300 ms > S2 > S1 > A1) and then play the reaction.

barista.note: Polishing: the cloth circles the cup through three drawn in-betweens, cuts at 140-200 ms (dissolves were tried and looked muddier: the cloth moves too far between neighbours). Glance: eyes only.

child.note: Colours with his head down (C_1/C_2, the crayon moves with a short dissolve), then looks up at his mum and grins (C_3, cuts).

oldman.note: v10d. Reads on O_1, the only reading pose, then turns the page in five drawn steps with cuts: he lifts the corner (T1), raises the page (T2), the page stands upright over the fold as his fingers leave it (R0), it falls to the left on its own while his hand comes back outside the paper (R1), and the page settles as his hand takes its grip again (R2). O_1 is three holds in a row (the same still, so nothing shows between them) because the engine fits at most one blink into a hold: this way he blinks every 3.0-6.3 s and turns a page every 5.2-6.6 s (5th-95th percentile; extremes 4.6-7.1 s; holds trimmed to 3 x [1287, 2137] ms for the longer turn), measured with the engine's splitCast/clipSchedule over 100 h. He blinks only on O_1, never mid-turn.

cat.note: v10e: opens on a short cat_1 rest (so its resting pose, shown during the paint-in, pause and reduced motion, is cat_1, not mid-flick), then flicks; cat_1 fades are 600 ms so they finish inside their 700-900 ms holds (no snap). Flick at the start of the loop and after 3 breaths (about 60% of the loop). Each breathe loop is cat_1 > cat_2 > cat_1: the two cat_1 holds meet when it repeats (an identical still, so nothing shows) and it always ends on cat_1, ready for the flick.

mum.note: Part of the plate: null = nothing drawn. v10b: her loop opens with the sip (after 50 ms of nothing, so that her rest pose, the routine's first still, stays the plate), then four blinks spread through the rest, never during the sip. Loop 21.8-23.4 s (5th-95th percentile). Each actor runs on its own random clock, so nothing in the engine can keep her sip away from Rachel's blinks for good. What the timing does: each time the scene starts (the café cast starts afresh on every visit, mum 0-0.9 s after Rachel) her first sip is over before Rachel can first blink (3.0 s at the earliest): clear by 0.2 s at worst, by 1 s or more 97% of the time. After that the two drift apart at random: measured with the engine's clipSchedule over 100 h, about 62% of sips come within 1 s of one of Rachel's blinks and about 33% overlap one, whatever the loop length.
